phase: Phase 10 Rainfall and Road-Risk Model Experiments & Scientific Evaluation
scientific_integrity_attestation: Sahaay AI strictly prioritizes scientific validity over manufacturing pseudo-accuracy. Because no timestamped ground-truth flood outcome labels exist, and because telemetry data exhibits >90% temporal missingness and accumulator counter confusion, supervised flood prediction and live temporal rainfall forecasting are formally recorded as NOT_RUN. Rules-based baselines are validated as the transparent operational reference standard.

rainfall_risk_engine.architecture: IMD-calibrated piecewise intensity and multi-window accumulation rules
rainfall_risk_engine.missing_data_semantics: rain_1h_mm=None strictly returns UNKNOWN (conf=0.10, score=0.0). Missing observations are NEVER silently converted to 0.0mm.
rainfall_risk_engine.confidence_discounting: Distance penalty (-0.01/km >15km, max -0.35); Staleness penalty (-0.08/h >1.5h, max -0.40); Missing window penalty (-0.08 per window).
rainfall_risk_engine.failure_modes: In convective cloudbursts localized within 2km, regional rain gauges (35-50km away) will underestimate intensity without radar/nowcast corroboration.

subscore_zones.drain: High overflow risk (0-100m: 1.0 to 0.60), Buffer (100-500m: 0.60 to 0.0), Low (>500m: 0.0)
subscore_zones.waterbody: Low-elevation lake bund (0-200m: 1.0 to 0.50), Slope (200-800m: 0.50 to 0.0), Minimal (>800m: 0.0)

road_vulnerability_engine.semantic_invariant: Static vulnerability represents underlying physical susceptibility, NOT active flooding. A SEVERE road is completely safe in dry weather.

track_b_unsupervised_exploratory_analysi.track_title: Track B — Unsupervised & Exploratory Data Analysis

temporal_gap_analysis.sampling_station_AKBR: 1,101 records over 2 years (effective coverage < 7%); max transmission gap = 141.6 days; 155 duplicate timestamps.
temporal_gap_analysis.sampling_station_Kondapochamma: 932 records over 2 years (effective coverage < 6%); max transmission gap = 71.3 days; 206 duplicate timestamps.
temporal_gap_analysis.conclusion: Discontinuous regional telemetry cannot be treated as a regular time series without extreme temporal distortion.

track_c_supervised_flood_ml_feasibility.track_title: Track C — Supervised Flood Prediction Feasibility
track_c_supervised_flood_ml_feasibility.decision_verdict: SUPERVISED FLOOD PREDICTION IS CURRENTLY INFEASIBLE
blocking_reasons: flooding_locations.kml contains 23 static historical placemarks with zero timestamps, dates, or depth measurements.
Real-world observation database contains exactly 0 observations (Phase 8 activation gate blocked at BLOCKED_NOT_READY_FOR_LIVE_PILOT).
Labeling static hotspots as positive targets causes 100% spatial target leakage, memorizing placemarks rather than predicting flood events.
Fitting an ML model to vulnerability index scores or IMD rainfall risk categories is rule imitation / formula distillation, not predictive ML.

required_data_to_unlock_supervised_ml.ground_truth_episodes: Minimum 50 verified flood episodes (water depth >= 5 cm) and 100 non-flood episodes across >= 4 storm dates.
required_data_to_unlock_supervised_ml.spatiotemporal_alignment: Timestamped physical ground observations aligned with synchronized AWS telemetry and LiDAR elevation.
required_data_to_unlock_supervised_ml.split_methodology: Location-held-out and storm-date-grouped splits to prevent spatial and temporal duplicate leakage.

track_d_rainfall_forecasting_experiment.track_title: Track D — Temporal Rainfall Forecasting Feasibility
track_d_rainfall_forecasting_experiment.decision_verdict: HOURLY TELEMETRY FORECASTING IS CURRENTLY INFEASIBLE
blocking_reasons: Telemetry station reporting is discontinuous (> 90% temporal missingness).
Massive multi-week gaps (up to 141.6 consecutive days with zero records).
Inconsistent mixed time deltas (0 minutes, 5 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, 5 hours).
50.82% of records reflect seasonal accumulator counters rather than incremental hourly rain.
Zero telemetry stations exist within the GHMC urban core; nearest station is 35-50 km away.
track_d_rainfall_forecasting_experiment.scientific_justification: Training autoregressive or neural sequence models on this telemetry would require either silently imputing 141 days of missing hours as zero rain (violating non-negotiable data rules) or concatenating across multi-month gaps as adjacent hours. A rigorous NOT_RUN result is recorded.
track_d_rainfall_forecasting_experiment.required_data_to_unlock_forecasting: Sub-hourly (15-min) telemetry stream with >= 98% uptime and automated counter differencing.

semantic_distinctions: Environmental susceptibility is NOT proof of current inundation.
High rainfall risk is NOT a verified flood observation.
Missing or stale rainfall data is UNKNOWN, never LOW.
A static hotspot is NOT a timestamped flood label.
Synthetic scenarios test software behavior, NOT real-world predictive accuracy.
